Amendment No. 7 to Schedule 13D
This Amendment No. 7 amends the Schedule 13D filed with the SEC on February 9, 2022, as previously amended.
Item 4. Purpose of Transaction.
On June 14, 2024, the Reporting Persons adopted a Rule 10b5-1 trading arrangement for the sale of up to 2,031,264 shares of Class A Common Stock. The sales are being done primarily for diversification purposes.
Date Reporting Person Shares Sold Price Range Weighted Average Price Per Share

August 6, 2024 David Blundin 65,540 $26.80 to $27.79 inclusive $27.08
Item 5. Interest in Securities of the Issuer.
Ownership is stated as of September 4, 2024 and ownership percentages are based upon 31,479,962 shares of Class A common stock and 3,604,278 shares of Class B common stock outstanding. The Class B Common Stock is convertible into Class A Common Stock on a one-for-one basis at the option of the holder. Other than as previously disclosed in this Amendment No. 7, there have been no reportable transactions with respect to the shares of the Issuer in the last 60 days.
Item 6. Contracts, Arrangements, Understandings or Relationships with respect to Securities of the Issuer.
The information set forth in Item 4 is incorporated by reference into this Item 6.
Item 7. Material to Be Filed as Exhibits.
99.1 Rule 10b5-1 Sales Plan. 99.2 Joint Filing Agreement.
